Module com.example.miniproyecto_batalla_naval
Package com.example.miniproyecto_batalla_naval.controller

Class GameController

java.lang.Object
com.example.miniproyecto_batalla_naval.controller.GameController
All Implemented Interfaces:
CellInteractionListener, BoardListener
public class GameController extends Object implements CellInteractionListener, BoardListener
Main controller for the Battleship game screen. Implements CellInteractionListener and BoardListener to receive user interactions, synchronize the graphical interface with the GameModel, manage the turn flow, update both game boards, execute machine turns, and coordinate persistence operations.

  • Method Details

    • startGame

      public void startGame(GameModel model)
      Starts a new Battleship match. Initializes the game model, builds both boards, renders the player's fleet, updates the turn indicator, performs an automatic save, and starts the game timer.
      Parameters:
      model - the game model containing the current match state

    • resumeGame

      public void resumeGame(GameModel savedModel)
      Restores a previously saved match. Rebuilds the graphical boards, restores their visual state, updates the turn indicator, and resumes the game timer. If it is currently the machine's turn, the corresponding action is executed automatically.
      Parameters:
      savedModel - the previously saved game model

    • setupBoards

      private void setupBoards()
      Builds both game boards and registers the listeners required to synchronize the graphical interface with the underlying model.

    • onCellChanged

      public void onCellChanged(Cell cell)
      Invoked whenever the state of a board cell changes. Updates the graphical representation of a board cell whenever its state changes in the game model.
      Specified by:
      onCellChanged in interface BoardListener
      Parameters:
      cell - the cell whose state has changed

    • onCellLeftClick

      public void onCellLeftClick(int row, int column)
      Invoked when the user performs a left-click on a board cell. Processes a left-click on the machine's board. Validates that the match is in a playable state, executes the shot, updates the graphical interface according to the obtained result, persists the game state, and transfers the turn when necessary.
      Specified by:
      onCellLeftClick in interface CellInteractionListener
      Parameters:
      row - the row index of the selected cell
      column - the column index of the selected cell

    • onCellRightClick

      public void onCellRightClick(int row, int column)
      Invoked when the user performs a right-click on a board cell. Right-click interactions are ignored during gameplay, since only left-click actions are used to fire shots.
      Specified by:
      onCellRightClick in interface CellInteractionListener
      Parameters:
      row - the row index of the selected cell
      column - the column index of the selected cell

    • startGameTimer

      private void startGameTimer()
      Starts the game timer in a background thread. The elapsed time is updated every second until the match finishes.

    • runMachineTurn

      private void runMachineTurn()
      Creates and starts a background thread responsible for executing the machine player's turn without blocking the JavaFX application thread.

    • onMachineShotResolved

      private void onMachineShotResolved(int row, int column, ShotResult result)
      Resolves the result of the machine's shot. Updates the interface, switches turns when appropriate, stores the current game state, and continues the machine's turn if another shot is granted.
      Parameters:
      row - the targeted row
      column - the targeted column
      result - the result produced by the machine's shot

    • applyMessage

      private void applyMessage(ShotResult result, boolean shotByHuman)
      Displays the appropriate gameplay message according to the result of the most recent shot.
      Parameters:
      result - the outcome of the executed shot
      shotByHuman - true if the shot was fired by the human player; false if it was fired by the machine
